checks.note: PasswordResetService.completePasswordReset indeed only encodes the password and calls user.completePasswordReset with no revocation call in this file, but the verdict depends on code not shown: the User.completePasswordReset entity method (could publish a domain event) and any event listeners/callers (finishPasswordReset, RefreshTokenRepository consumers) that might revoke tokens out-of-band.

The grace-window branch of AuthService.refresh reassigns `token` via findFirstByUserIdAndUsedFalseAndExpiresAtAfterOrderByCreatedAtDesc (account-wide, no lineage to the presented token) and falls through to the normal rotation path, issuing a new JWT and refresh cookie to the stale-token presenter with no reuse revocation — markAllUsedByUserId/invalidateSessionsForUser fire only in the orElseGet and the outside-grace else branch. The verification caveat (SPA refresh cadence) is not determinable from this file, but it only affects how long the ping-pong persists, not the code-level mechanism.

Both AuthService.login and AuthService.refresh compute `String role = user.getSkillarsRole() != null ? user.getSkillarsRole().name() : "ADMIN"` and write it into the LoginResponse and SkillarsProfileCookie; no guard blocks null-role users — ensureAccountIsLive checks only activated/locked/SUSPENDED, and login()'s phone-OTP verification gate is itself skipped when skillarsRole is null. The downstream SPA-trust and registration claims rest on code outside this file, but the described trigger produces the described ADMIN labelling exactly as stated.

UserProfileService.updateUserEmail does set email and login immediately after only a password + old-email check, with no in-file pending/confirm state. But the finding's verification caveat — that no confirm-link flow exists in ProfileResource.updateEmail or AccountManagementFacade.changeEmail — cannot be checked, as neither file is shown; the facade could gate this call behind a new-address confirmation.

resendRegistrationLink does gate only on activationDate==null plus passwordResetService.isPasswordMatch with no per-account failure recording, but the finding's verification caveat — that @RateLimited state is the in-memory RateLimitingService (per-IP, per-instance) — cannot be checked: the RateLimited aspect/RateLimitingService and PasswordResetService.isPasswordMatch implementations are not in the provided file.

Binding mechanics are real: registerLinkResend has no @RequestBody/@RequestParam so login/password bind from request parameters, and AccountResource lacks @Validated so @NotNull is unenforced. But the claimed NPE path is a misread — the method returns Success with an empty Map.of(), not Map.of("login", login); a null login just flows into accountManagementFacade.resendRegistrationLink. The log-exposure consequence depends on the verification caveat (SPA client behavior, LoggingFilter/proxy query-string logging), none of which is in this file.

AppEndpoints.PUBLIC_MGMT_ENDPOINTS does contain "/manage/prometheus" and the static block adds it to ALL_UNRESTRICTED, but confirming public exposure requires SecurityConfiguration (does it permitAll() these lists, and is that rule ordered before the /manage/** ROLE_ADMIN rule from SECURED_MAPPINGS?) plus the reverse-proxy config named in the finding's verification caveat — none of which is shown.

No reported finding mentions the activate.security flag or the permit-all fallback in SecurityConfiguration.
